_: Shared by src/grep.test.ts and the JetBrains plugin's PlaywrightGrepTest. `grep` is the exact pattern for the titles; `selects` and `rejects` are what Playwright would match it against, after the project and file: the titles and tags joined with spaces. `kind` is feature, scenario or outline.

cases.name: a scenario matches only itself
cases.grep: Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart(?: @\S+)*$
selects: Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart
rejects: Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart twice
Feature: Admin Scenario: Customer clears cart
Feature: Storefront Shopping Extra Scenario: Customer clears cart

cases.name: a scenario still matches itself when Playwright appends its tags
cases.grep: Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart(?: @\S+)*$
selects: Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart @libraries
Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart @libraries @smoke @timeout:5000
rejects: Feature: Storefront Shopping Scenario: Customer clears cart twice @smoke

cases.name: a pattern is not case sensitive, as Playwright makes it
a feature matches all of its scenarios and no other feature
titles with regular expression characters are matched literally
cases.grep: Feature: F Scenario: Cart \(empty\) costs \$0\.00 \[a\|b\] a\+b\? c\\d \{1\} \^ \/(?: @\S+)*$
selects: Feature: F Scenario: Cart (empty) costs $0.00 [a|b] a+b? c\d {1} ^ /
rejects: Feature: F Scenario: Cart empty costs $0x00 a|b aab c\d 1 ^ /

cases.name: a title with spaces around it is matched as Playwright is given it, trimmed
an outline matches each of its examples, a placeholder standing for the example's value
cases.grep: Feature: Order checkout Scenario: A cart with .* keyboards(?: @\S+)*$
selects: Feature: Order checkout Scenario: A cart with 1 keyboards
Feature: Order checkout Scenario: A cart with 25 keyboards @libraries @smoke
rejects: Feature: Order checkout Scenario: A cart with 1 mice
Feature: Order checkout Scenario: A cart with 1 keyboards and a mouse
Feature: Cart Scenario: A cart with 1 keyboards

cases.name: an outline with several placeholders, and one that starts a title
an outline whose title has no placeholder is just its title
